Airflow checks and some useful tips
The desk is glad to help midweek
Urgent Travel Notice for Companion Animals

Travelers must review all animal travel guidance before departure. Aurelia Skyways requires careful preparation so that pets remain safe, calm, and properly accepted at check-in.

The Companion Animal Travel Desk issues clear guidance before each journey and checks that carrier, feed, and health details are in order. The senior coordinator oversees daily service decisions and may pause a booking if any safety concern appears. Please do not assume routine acceptance.

If you are traveling with Frankie or any other pet, bring complete documents and follow every instruction given by the desk. Do not wait until arrival to raise a concern, because delays can place the animal at risk and may interrupt travel plans.

Contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before you depart.
